inviabiliCandidatureDesc: Public «Work with us» form: applications arrive in the «Applications» tab. It does not go through the form builder and cannot be reset, because its fields end up in typed columns and in a closed list of age ranges in the database, not in free-form JSON.
inviabiliCandidatureSediNota: One link for all locations: applicants choose the location inside the form.
candIntro: Applications received from the public «Work with us» form. Management approves or rejects them: approving a TEACHING one creates the teacher account and sends the credentials, the others are closed without creating any access.
candSelezionaDettagli: Select an application to see its details.

candNessunaFascia: None (this is not a teaching application)
candConfermaApprovaSenzaAccount: This application includes no teaching position: NO account will be created and no credentials email will be sent. The application is closed as approved. If access is needed, create it from the Staff panel.
candEsitoApprovataSenzaAccount: Application approved without creating any account: there is no password to hand over and no access to look for. If this person is hired, the account is created when you approve their staff record, and the credentials are emailed from there.
candCvBloccato: The browser blocked the CV from opening in a new tab.

candRuoloInCorso: Checking your role: in a moment we will know whether this account can decide.
candSospesaTesto: The teacher account WAS CREATED and the credentials have already been generated, but the application is not marked as approved. Do not press “Approve” again and do not reject it: report it to support.
candSospesaAzioniSpente: Approve and Reject stay off while the application is being approved: the account already exists, and rejecting it would send a rejection email to someone who has just received their credentials.

inviabiliPersonaleDesc: Public form “Staff personal details”: submissions arrive in the “Staff” tab. It is for people who ALREADY have a contract with the school — “Work with us” stays for those applying. It does not go through the form builder and cannot be reset.
inviabiliPersonaleSediNota: One link for all locations: the person filling it in chooses the location inside the form.
inviabiliPersonaleAvviso: Do not send it to families: it asks for a tax code and a scan of an identity document, and the link is open to whoever receives it.
pratIntro: Staff personal details received from the public form. The school office approves or rejects them: approving one files the final record and, if the person has no account yet, opens one.
pratVuotoFiltrato: No staff details received in the locations you are looking at:
pratVuotoFiltratoNota: The other locations have not been read: a submission may have arrived there, and from this station you would not see it.

pratSospesaTesto: The staff record was filed and the account may already have been created, but the submission is not marked as approved. Do not press “Approve” again: from here the only action left is “Reject”, which files the submission away without deleting the staff record or the account. Report it to support.
pratSospesaAzioniSpente: Approve and Move to another location stay off: the submission has already been taken in charge and the server turns both down. “Reject” stays available — it is the only way to close it.
pratAzioneInCorso: An action on this submission is still running: the buttons stay off until the answer arrives, so it cannot be sent twice.
pratAvvisoAccountOrfano: A sign-in account WAS left created without a profile: pressing “Approve” again will NOT generate any password. Credentials can only be obtained with “Regenerate credentials” from the Staff panel — report this to support.
pratAvvisoProfiloPreesistente: This person already had a profile: ROLE, LOCATION and AGE GROUPS were left exactly as they were — a public form does not promote anyone, does not move anyone between locations and does not widen anyone’s age groups.
pratAvvisoAccountAltraSede: This person’s account is registered at {sede}, not at the location of the request: the staff record was written on the person, therefore at that location. If the location is wrong, change it from the Staff panel.
pratAvvisoFasceNonApplicate: The age groups declared in the form ({fasce}) were NOT applied: age groups decide which classes and which children a person reaches, and a public form does not change them for someone who already has an account. If they really need changing, assign them from the Staff panel.
pratAvvisoFasceAssentiNuovo: The request carries no valid age group: the account was created WITHOUT age groups, so this person will not see any class until one is assigned from the Staff panel.
pratAvvisoFasceAssentiEsistente: The request carries no valid age group: the account’s age groups were left as they were.
pratAvvisoFasceNonRegistrate: The age groups ({fasce}) were NOT recorded on the account: this environment is missing the column. They have to be assigned from the Staff panel.
pratAvvisoCredenzialiEmailNonInviata: The account was created but the email with the credentials did NOT go out: the password below is the only copy in existence. Hand it over in person, or regenerate it from the Staff panel.
pratAvvisoAccountCreatoLoStesso: This person’s account WAS created anyway: pressing “Approve” again will reuse it, and no second account will be created.
pratAvvisoFascicoloParziale: Staff record only partly saved: this environment is missing the columns {colonne}.
pratAvvisoAccountNonAggiornato: The staff record was saved, but updating the account did NOT succeed: name, surname and mobile number on the account were left as they were. They have to be corrected from the Staff panel.
pratAvvisoAccountAltroPlesso: This person is assigned to a location this workstation does not manage: name, surname and mobile number were NOT updated. The staff record was saved all the same.
pratAvvisoAccountColonneCadute: Some data was not updated on the account: this environment is missing the columns {colonne}.
pratAvvisoChiusuraParziale: Closing only partly recorded: this environment is missing the columns {colonne}.
pratAvvisoChiusuraParzialeNonLegata: Closing only partly recorded: this environment is missing the columns {colonne}. The request is NOT linked to the account: do NOT press “Approve” again — report this to support.
pratAvvisoApprovazioneNonMarcata: The staff record WAS saved but the request is not marked as approved: do NOT press “Approve” again — report this to support.
pratAvvisoRifiutoParziale: Rejection only partly recorded: this environment is missing the columns {colonne}.
pratAvvisoSpostamentoParziale: Move only partly recorded: this environment is missing the columns {colonne}.

pratCredenzialiInviate: They have also been emailed to the address above. Here they are shown once only: once this panel is closed they can only be regenerated from the Staff panel.
pratNessunaCredenziale: No password generated: this person already had an account.

pratConfermaAccountEffetto: On approval, that account’s name, surname and mobile number and the whole staff record (tax code, birth, residence, ID document) will be OVERWRITTEN with the ones from this form. Role, location and age groups stay as they are.
pratConfermaAccountAltraSede: This email ALREADY has an account, registered at a location this workstation does not manage: the approval will be refused and nothing will be written. It has to be approved by the Head Office or from a workstation that manages that location.
pratConfermaAccountGenitore: This email ALREADY has an account, and it belongs to a PARENT: the approval will be refused and nothing will be written. Linking a teacher who is also a mother to her parent account is a decision for the office, not for a public form: use a different email address, or do it by hand from the Staff panel.
pratConfermaAccountIgnoto: It was not possible to check whether this email already has an account: if it does, its profile and staff record will be overwritten with the data from this form.
pratConfermaAccountNuovo: No account with this email: a new one will be created, with the Teacher role.
pratConfermaApprovaFasceRegola: Age groups decide which classes and which children this person reaches. They are applied ONLY if the account is created now: if one already exists, the existing groups stay and are changed from the Staff panel.
pratConfermaSpentaMotivo: “Confirm” is off: with this outcome the approval cannot succeed and nothing would be written. Close with “Cancel”.
pratConfermaRifiutaTesto: The submission will be filed as rejected. No account is created and nothing is written to the account of
pratConfermaRifiutaSospesa: This submission had already been taken in charge: the staff record and the account, if they were created, STAY — rejecting only closes the submission, and frees the email address for a new one from the public form. If that is not what you want, cancel and report it to support.
pratMotivoAiuto: It is an internal note: it stays in the school office, no email is sent and it never reaches the technical logs.
